name: firewall-map-renderer
description: Builds the plugin's browser scripts: firewall-map-renderer.js (src/, vite.config.js) with its third-party license file, firewall-map-page.js (page/, vite.page.config.js) and the development-only firewall-map-diagnostics.js (page/diagnostics.js, vite.diagnostics.config.js). Run tools/build-renderer.sh from the repository root: it installs the pinned versions from package-lock.json (npm ci), builds, tests and copies the results into src/opnsense/www/js.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.page.config.js && vite build --config vite.diagnostics.config.js
